The prior Project record states U>=17 but does not bind all inherited compatible identities to names, so this record separates exact named U=6 from inherited U_lower_bound>=17 rather than fabricating target identities. Consequential DO=false; no merge, release, deploy, external publish, or commerce actuation performed by CELL3.
